subject: Architecture
title: The Bird's Nest: Beijing's Olympic Statement
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Bird's Nest: Beijing's Olympic Statement.

hook.text: Beijing's Olympic stadium looks like a giant nest of twisted steel ribbons weighing 42,000 tons.

buildup.text: Swiss architects Herzog & de Meuron designed it with Chinese artist Ai Weiwei as consultant.

discovery.text: The steel strips serve double duty: structural support and decorative facade merged into one system.

twist.text: Ai Weiwei later called the stadium propaganda and refused to attend the opening ceremony.

climax.text: The Bird's Nest hosted both the 2008 and 2022 Olympics — summer and winter in the same stadium.

punchline.text: Its co-creator won't go inside. The world can't stop looking.

quiz.question: Who was the artistic consultant for the Bird's Nest stadium?
